check_id: ALCOA+-Accurate/sql/gold/channel_quality/SELECT lid_text(lid_from_uuid(lid)) AS offender FROM gold_channel_quality WHERE rms_uv < {{rms_uv_min}} OR rms_uv > {{rms_uv_max}} ORDER BY rms_uv DESC/1/1000
control: the root mean square amplitude of a channel is between 1 and 1000 microvolts, the range a cortical electrode records
sql:
-- sql at severity flag: the records the requirement's own query found, not how many. A failure
-- is recorded and does not stop the build, so the evidence has to name what to go and look at.
-- The query returns one column, `offender`, already ordered. Expected: 'no records'.
WITH found AS (SELECT lid_text(lid_from_uuid(lid)) AS offender FROM gold_channel_quality WHERE rms_uv < 1 OR rms_uv > 1000 ORDER BY rms_uv DESC)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'no records'
            ELSE count(*)::VARCHAR || ' of ' || (SELECT count(*) FROM gold_channel_quality)::VARCHAR || ': '
                 || list_aggregate(list_slice(list(offender), 1, 5), 'string_agg', ', ')
                 || CASE WHEN count(*) > 5 THEN ' and more' ELSE '' END
       END AS observed
FROM found;

check_id: ALCOA+-Accurate/sql/gold/experiment_summary/WITH rate AS (SELECT experiment, subject_pid, 60.0 * n_events / nullif(duration_s, 0) AS per_minute FROM gold_experiment_summary), band AS (SELECT experiment, median(per_minute) AS middle FROM rate GROUP BY experiment) SELECT r.experiment || ' ' || r.subject_pid AS offender FROM rate r JOIN band b USING (experiment) WHERE r.per_minute < {{low_multiple}} * b.middle OR r.per_minute > {{high_multiple}} * b.middle ORDER BY r.per_minute DESC/0.5/2
control: a subject records events at between 0.5 and 2 times the median rate of its experiment
sql:
-- sql at severity flag: the records the requirement's own query found, not how many. A failure
-- is recorded and does not stop the build, so the evidence has to name what to go and look at.

WITH found AS (WITH rate AS (SELECT experiment, subject_pid, 60.0 * n_events / nullif(duration_s, 0) AS per_minute FROM gold_experiment_summary), band AS (SELECT experiment, median(per_minute) AS middle FROM rate GROUP BY experiment) SELECT r.experiment || ' ' || r.subject_pid AS offender FROM rate r JOIN band b USING (experiment) WHERE r.per_minute < 0.5 * b.middle OR r.per_minute > 2 * b.middle ORDER BY r.per_minute DESC)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 0 THEN 'no records'
            ELSE count(*)::VARCHAR || ' of ' || (SELECT count(*) FROM gold_experiment_summary)::VARCHAR || ': '
